risks.risk: The laptop may not have 8GB RAM or a 320GB HDD as claimed.
risks.proof: A photo of the BIOS/UEFI screen showing system information, or a screenshot from Windows Task Manager or System Properties showing RAM and storage details.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as having less than 8GB RAM or a smaller/missing HDD, which significantly reduces value.

risks.risk: The CPU may not be a 7th Gen Intel Pentium; it could be a lower or higher generation, or a different brand.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the CPU label on the motherboard or a screenshot from CPU-Z or similar software showing the exact CPU model.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as having an unknown or lower-tier CPU, which reduces value.

risks.risk: The laptop may have physical damage not visible in photos, such as cracked hinges, screen damage, or keyboard issues.
risks.proof: A close-up video or photo of the hinges, screen edges, and keyboard under different lighting angles.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as having potential cosmetic or functional damage, which reduces value.

risks.risk: The laptop may not power on or may have software issues (e.g., Windows activation, malware).
risks.proof: A video showing the laptop booting up, logging into Windows, and running a simple task (e.g., opening a browser).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not working or with software issues, which reduces value.

proof_requests: A screenshot from Windows System Properties or Task Manager showing RAM and storage details.
A screenshot from CPU-Z or similar software showing the exact CPU model.
A video showing the laptop booting up and running Windows smoothly.
Close-up photos of the hinges, screen edges, and keyboard.
